note: zfix round 2026-11-09: misfiled draft/triple-double inputs detached from series_and_cup; canonical pick ledger and slot model replace their audited duplicates (draft_pick_ownership_graph, prospect_board_dispersion) in awards_draft.

attach.why: Pick-slot, team-to-draft and range contracts (KXNBATOP3, KXNBATOPPICK and the draft-pick-range series) settle on who holds each pick as much as on prospect choice; the ledger carries original team, owner, protection, swap and rollover so a top-N pick is mapped to the right team. It replaces nba.draft_pick_ownership_graph, which the input audit flags as a duplicate of it.

Slot, range (top-5/10/15/20/30), KXNBATOP3 and KXNBATOP5ROTY contracts need P(prospect taken at or before slot k) from a market-free ranked-choice model on public boards, measurables and team need; it replaces nba.prospect_board_dispersion (audited as a strict subset of it) and the market-contaminated nba.draft_board consensus as the slot driver.
